defects_found_in_v1.defect: All 5 sequences were stored TRUNCATED to 53 chars ending in a literal '...' ellipsis, while declaring sequence_length 400/372/1956/839/93.
defects_found_in_v1.evidence: stored_len=53 for every entry; sequence.endswith('...')==True for all 5.
defects_found_in_v1.consequence: The Colab script prompts ESM3 with a 50-residue fragment plus '...'; every generated variant would be a fragment continuation, not an OPRM1 variant. ddG vs the 400aa control set would compare different-length objects.

defects_found_in_v1.defect: esm3_oprm1_v2.json target_protein.sequence is not OPRM1 at all: it is the first 50 residues of shuffled control random_0 plus '...'.
defects_found_in_v1.evidence: spec target[:50]=='GPNNGYLTWHLRSIIFSLPSVNGAMALMFKWGGLSSFVSGQVYKSIGPIT'; identical to control_sequences.shuffled[0][:50]. Real OPRM1 N-term is 'MDSSAAPTNASNCTDALAYSS...'.
defects_found_in_v1.consequence: The spec's declared target was a SHUFFLED CONTROL. Executing as written would have prompted ESM3 with scrambled sequence and compared it against controls derived from the true protein.

defects_found_in_v1.defect: Accession Q9Y5Y9 labeled 'SCN9A' is SCN10A (Nav1.8), a different gene.
defects_found_in_v1.evidence: UniProt Q9Y5Y9 geneName=SCN10A, 'Sodium channel protein type 10 subunit alpha'. Canonical SCN9A is Q15858 (1988 aa, Nav1.7).
defects_found_in_v1.consequence: Wrong gene. Nav1.7 is the validated pain target (congenital insensitivity to pain); Nav1.8 is a different channel.

defects_found_in_v1.defect: Colab script hardcodes only 4 of the 5 genes (OPRD1 present, SCN9A silently dropped) with the same truncated strings.
defects_found_in_v1.consequence: Silent scope reduction not declared anywhere.

recovery_note: The control set was NOT corrupt: consensus over the 100 mutated_70pct controls recovers UniProt P35372 at 100.0% identity over all 400 positions. Identity to real OPRM1: mutated_70pct 70.0% (exact, all 100), shuffled 6.0% mean, uniform 4.9% mean. The controls are sound and reusable; only the prompt inputs and the spec target were broken.

selection_criteria.c1_len_max: <=1024 aa — ESM3 open-weights practical context on a free-tier T4
selection_criteria.c2_len_min: >=50 aa — below this FoldX ddG has no interpretable signal
selection_criteria.c3_structure_available: a PDB structure must exist, else FoldX ddG and Vina docking cannot run at all
selection_criteria.c4_accession_verified: UniProt gene name must match the label, fetched from rest.uniprot.org (independent of the channel that proposed it)

SCN9A.protein_name: Sodium channel protein type 9 subunit alpha

TRPV1.protein_name: Transient receptor potential cation channel subfamily V member 1

natural_friction: El target del spec no era OPRM1 sino el control shuffled_0 truncado. Lo detecte porque los 400aa de control y los 53 del target no podian compararse; el consenso de los mutantes recupero la real al 100%.
